observedFacts.claim: At 868 s the selected Armor is +3 and the displayed next-upgrade Chocosteel cost is 4 with 40 held.
At 875 and 880 s the Super result shows +3 to +5 and one visible Chocosteel row with quantity 1.
Chocosteel wallet shows 40 before and 37 after; Metal Syrup wallet shows 2 in both frames.
No protection control or extra protection-cost row is displayed in the +3 precondition frame; downgrade and break probabilities are zero.
The displayed Super 10% at 868 s is outcome probability, not a visible refund percentage.

inferences.claim: The precondition and result most likely belong to the same Armor +3 upgrade attempt.
inferences.basis: Same plate slot and result's own from-grade +3; seven seconds between captures.
inferences.limitation: Frames 869–874 and the exact click/continuous playback were not archived. The video is an edited guide, so uninterrupted continuity and manual versus automatic initiation are not proven.

inferences.claim: Observed wallet difference is consistent with paying 4 and retaining/receiving 1 Chocosteel, net consumption 3.
inferences.limitation: No Payments/Rewards response captured. The UI calls this materials left, so the screenshot cannot separately distinguish a smaller debit from a full debit followed by a server refund.

unconditional.ceilVersusMinimumOne: Not distinguishable from one small positive returned quantity.
unconditional.floorOrNearestForCurrentVersion: Not excluded; the historical in-video refund percentage and current version binding are missing.
unconditional.baseOnlyVersusAllPaidMaterials: Not distinguishable; no protection material was visibly charged in this low-grade case.
unconditional.multiMaterialRefundUi: Only one row observed for this case; does not establish global refund scope.

conditionalIllustration.assumption: If this historical +3 attempt used the same 10% refund rate as the separately extracted October table, then 4 x 10% = 0.4.
conditionalIllustration.interpretation: Observed 1 would conflict with strict floor/nearest under that unverified assumption and fit ceil or minimum-one variants. This is not accepted proof of current rounding.
additionalPossibleCandidates: Another server rule or UI debit convention

remainingEvidenceRequirements: A current-build attempt showing its actual refund-rate detail and readable paid Chocosteel cost, followed by Super result quantities.
At least one non-integer product above one, such as current pre-grade +6 cost 7 at 25%, to distinguish floor-with-minimum-one from ceil.
A paid-protection Super attempt with nonzero protection cost and theoretically observable refund, or recorded Payments/Rewards item IDs and amounts, to resolve material scope.
